title: 阿里自由现金流转负：为何发股，不发债？
speaker: Robert Leib

segments.en: I think Alibaba does have balance sheet strength. It has, you know, or previously, had a strong free cash flow generation.
segments.zh: 阿里资产负债表稳健，此前自由现金流强劲。

segments.en: But again, on the back of several results now, including last week, free cash flow generation has gone negative. They need to raise capital as a result for a business, which is ultimately a utility service with very poor financial returns.
segments.zh: 但近期财报显示自由现金流转负，需要融资，而该业务本质是公共服务，财务回报不佳。

segments.en: Yeah, that is an interesting one, and I wonder what sort of advice they got on the back of that, because I think, you know, into the results last week, the shared had performed relatively strongly, you know, it outperformed its peers.
segments.zh: 这很有趣，财报前股价表现相对强劲，跑赢同行。

segments.en: So maybe there was a judgment taken that, you know, there's good investment appetite. You know, clearly we've got very strong top-line growth in our cloud business. You know, we can tap investors in the equity markets for that.
segments.zh: 或许判断市场有配置意愿，云业务收入增长强劲，可通过股权市场融资。

segments.en: But yes, absolutely, it runs contrary to what's happening in the US at the moment. And for a business we're just sitting on in that cash position, why didn't they issue debt instead, assuming they could lock into, you know, an interesting rate.
segments.zh: 这与美国市场做法相反，既然有现金，为何不发债锁定利率？

segments.en: So, you know, potentially there's a bit of misjudgment on the market movement sentiment there, and we've seen these comments from Michael Barry as well, you know, which in his view that the stock's overvalued.
segments.zh: 可能对市场情绪判断有误，Michael Barry也认为估值偏高。

segments.en: So, you know, I think overall, this is all a big dent to sentiment to state the obvious given what's happening with the stock price at the moment. But the returns are just not there, you know, in pure financial terms, their AI strategy since they embarked on this path has been value-destructive.
segments.zh: 整体上，股价表现打击信心，从财务角度看，AI战略自启动以来在破坏价值。
